post.description: Username + password, nothing else; signs the new user in. Open until MAX_USERS users exist.
Signs out every other session of the user; this browser stays signed in.

put.description:
Check the key with Zernio, store it, and pull its Instagram accounts. 422 ZERNIO_KEY_INVALID (not a key, or
refused); 409 ZERNIO_USER_CLAIMED (another Clipper user has that Zernio account), ZERNIO_ACCOUNT_CHANGED (your
accounts are another Zernio account's), KEY_IN_USE (a post is publishing); 503 when keys can't be stored.

delete.description:
Any time but while a post is publishing (409 KEY_IN_USE): a post that may be live never replays under a later
key, so this can't make a second Reel. The Zernio account stays recorded, so a later key must be that account's
while you have its Instagram accounts (ZERNIO_ACCOUNT_CHANGED).

post.description:
The Re-check button: verify the stored key again and re-pull its accounts. A key Zernio refuses is marked
invalid (200: zernio.status, zernio.error); a working one valid again, and a paused user's posts go out again.

Check the token with Telegram (getMe), store it sealed, and hand out a pairing code. 422 TOKEN_REJECTED (not a
token, or Telegram refuses it); 409 BOT_IN_USE (it has a webhook: another app gets its messages), BOT_TAKEN (another
Clipper user added it). Your own bot again with a new token (@BotFather /revoke) keeps its chat.
A new pairing code: the chat that uses it becomes the bot's (the current one answers until then).

delete.description: The bot service stops it within ~10 s.

post.description: Send the bot's chat a message now, from here (not the bot service): ok, or Telegram's reason.
Multipart upload, streamed to raw/. The clip is UPLOADING while the bytes arrive, then PROBING.
The video links in a document (docx, xlsx, pptx, odt) or a text file. Nothing is imported.
One DOWNLOADING clip per video that isn't in the library yet.

delete.description: Only READY/FAILED clips with no renders (delete the renders first). Files go too.

post.description: FAILED -> PROBING again if the bytes are here, else DOWNLOADING again (url clips).
A PNG with transparency. Stored under a new name each time, so browsers never show a stale logo.

get.description: unscheduled: renders with no post other than CANCELLED ones, and not superseded by a re-render.

delete.description:
Not while RENDERING, and not while a live (non-CANCELLED) post refers to it. Its CANCELLED posts
and files go too. FOR UPDATE: a cover change in flight lands first, so its file is the one deleted.

put.description:
The Reel cover (Zernio instagramThumbnail): a JPEG, ideally 1080x1920 (the Editor sends exactly that).
Stored under a new name each time, so browsers never show a stale cover. 409 once the render has posts.

delete.description: Back to Instagram's own pick. 409 once the render has posts.

get.description: The default first, then by name.
The default first, then the newest.

post.description:
A JPEG up to 8 MB (the web app sends 1080x1920). The Editor uploads a copy as a render's cover, so
renaming or deleting this one never changes a render.

delete.description: The file goes too (after the commit). Renders keep their own copies.
